description.en: A 35 mm half-frame film camera with a built-in prime lens, an optical bright-frame viewfinder and manually selected focus zones.
description.zh-cn: 一台使用 35 mm 胶卷的半格相机，配备内置定焦镜头和亮框光学取景器，拍摄时按距离手动选对焦档。

en: Hold the camera horizontally in its usual shooting position and the film records a vertical 17 × 24 mm image. The same type of 35 mm film can also be used in cameras that expose a 36 × 24 mm frame. “35 mm” names the film size and “half-frame” describes the area used for each picture.

The X-T5 uses a 23.5 × 15.7 mm APS-C sensor, with an area of 368.95 mm². The Pentax 17 exposes 408 mm² of film. The comparison shows physical size and shape. Field of view also depends on focal length and which dimension you compare. The lens, recording medium and processing all affect image quality.

The built-in lens stays attached and has one focal length, 25 mm. In Standard mode, estimate the subject distance and select a focus zone. The GFX100RF also has a built-in prime lens and offers autofocus.
zh-cn: 正常横持机身时，胶片记录的是一幅宽 17 mm、高 24 mm 的竖幅照片。同一种 35 mm 胶卷也能用于拍摄 36 × 24 mm 标准画幅的相机。「35 mm」说的是胶卷规格，「半格」说的是每张照片使用的曝光区域。
X-T5 使用宽 23.5 mm、高 15.7 mm 的 APS-C 传感器，面积为 368.95 mm²。Pentax 17 的胶片曝光面积为 408 mm²。对照图呈现的是记录区域的实际尺寸和形状。视角还取决于焦距和所比较的方向，画质则受镜头、记录介质和处理方式影响。
内置镜头不能更换，只有 25 mm 一个焦距。在标准拍摄模式下，估计主体距离，再手动选择对焦档。GFX100RF 同样配有内置定焦镜头，并支持自动对焦。
